definitions.explanation: A tax added to the purchase price of goods and services.

examples.japanese: {消費税|しょうひぜい}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is the price including tax.

examples.japanese: {消費税|しょうひぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げられた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。

notes:
{消費税|しょうひぜい} is the value-added tax applied to goods and services in Japan.

CURRENT RATES:
The standard rate is 10% (as of 2019). A reduced 8% rate applies to food and beverages (excluding alcohol and dining out) and newspaper subscriptions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {消費税|しょうひぜい}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ / ⟦{税込|ぜいこ}み→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧: price including tax
- ⟦{税|ぜい}{抜|ぬ}き→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧ / ⟦{税|ぜい}{別|べつ}→税別：28617_zeibetsu⟧: price before tax
- {消費税|しょうひぜい}⟦{増税|ぞうぜい}→増税：12091_zouzei⟧: consumption tax increase
- ⟦{軽減|けいげん}→軽減：16954_keigen⟧⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧: reduced tax rate

USAGE:
Prices in stores may be displayed as ⟦{税込|ぜいこ}み→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧ (tax included) or ⟦{税抜|ぜいぬ}き→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧ (tax excluded). Always check which is displayed.
